AcCounts.description: Passing and total acceptance criteria, and how many are owner steps.
AcCounts.title: AcCounts

AcceptLearningBody.description:
``POST /learnings/{learning_id}/accept``: the brain folder (or ``.md`` path) to move the
note to, relative to ``brain/``.
AcceptLearningBody.title: AcceptLearningBody

ActivityItem.description: A notable event in the activity feed.
ActivityItem.title: ActivityItem

Actor.description:
Who acted in a session (S2): the main agent, or a subagent of a type.

A subagent carries its ``agent_id`` and, when its start is linked to the main agent's
Agent tool call, that call's ``description`` and ``started_by_event_id``.
Actor.title: Actor

AgentSession.description:
One session ``hub web`` started (or one cloud start, ``kind="cloud"``).

``claude_session_id`` links it to the hook-observed Session once ``init`` arrives (or at
start when the id is given, P13); ``observed_session_id`` is that Session's id once it has
been observed, else ``null`` (a twin may never arrive, D2). ``last_seq`` is the last
persisted record's ``seq``. ``cost_usd`` and ``usage`` add up the turns' results (an estimate).
AgentSession.title: AgentSession

AgentSessionStatus.description:
Where a session is (P18): ``idle`` between turns, ``running`` in a turn,
``waiting_permission`` while a request is unanswered; ``ended`` and ``failed`` are final.
AgentSessionStatus.title: AgentSessionStatus

Approval.description:
An approval. ``decided`` once a matching result exists; ``inferred`` when the decision is
deduced (a guard ask with no tool run before the next prompt or stop is declined).

``how_to_decide`` is the terminal command that answers it, since Phase 2 is read-only:
``cd <hub path> && claude --resume <session id>``.
Approval.title: Approval

ApprovalKind.description: The kinds of request D24 lists.
ApprovalKind.title: ApprovalKind

BrainEntry.description: One ``.md`` note of the tree and its size in bytes.
BrainEntry.title: BrainEntry

BrainNote.description:
One note: its frontmatter fields, its markdown body (without the frontmatter) and size.

``frontmatter_problem`` says why the frontmatter could not be read (then ``frontmatter`` is
empty and ``markdown`` is the whole text).
BrainNote.title: BrainNote

BrainTree.description:
The ``.md`` notes of a hub's brain, sorted by path (``auto/`` and hidden names excluded).

``truncated`` says the listing stopped at a cap; ``skipped`` counts what was left out
(unreadable folders, entries past a cap).
BrainTree.title: BrainTree

BundledFile.description:
A file of a skill folder other than ``SKILL.md`` (S7): ``path`` is relative to the skill
folder, ``id`` server-issued; ``link`` when it is a link (never read), ``too_large`` when over
the per-file cap.
BundledFile.title: BundledFile

BundledFileText.description: A bundled file's text, inert (S7); ``binary`` (NUL or not UTF-8) gives no text.
BundledFileText.title: BundledFileText

CatalogItem.description:
One card of the catalog (D3, AC-164.7).

``description`` is the first line, at most 200 characters; ``invocation`` is
``/<name> <argument-hint>`` for a skill, None for an agent or a hook; ``mode`` is None for an
agent or a hook; ``usage`` is None for a hook. ``linked_from`` lists the ``.claude/`` links
that point at the item; ``active`` is false for a plugin hook whose plugin is not enabled;
``state`` is set for hooks only.
CatalogItem.title: CatalogItem

CloudSession.description: A session started in the cloud (D8): where to open it and how to teleport it here.
CloudSession.title: CloudSession

CloudSessionList.description: ``GET /agent-sessions/cloud``: the persisted cloud starts, newest first, at most 50.
CloudSessionList.title: CloudSessionList

CollectorStatus.description: ``GET /collector/status``: what ``hub web`` received and stored since it started.
CollectorStatus.title: CollectorStatus

ContextCost.description:
Approximate tokens (characters / 4, P8): ``always_loaded_tokens`` from the description (0
when the model cannot invoke the skill), ``on_invoke_tokens`` from the body.
ContextCost.title: ContextCost

CreateAgentSession.description:
``POST /agent-sessions``: where, how, and an optional first prompt (its byte size is
checked against the message limit, 413), or a past session to resume (and fork).
``screenshot`` goes with the first prompt as an image, so it needs one.
CreateAgentSession.title: CreateAgentSession

Diagnostic.description: One informational finding on an item, in one hub-relative line (D5, P6).
Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

DiagnosticCode.description: Every diagnostic an item can carry (P6).
DiagnosticCode.title: DiagnosticCode

DiagnosticSeverity.description: How much a diagnostic matters; never blocking (D5).
DiagnosticSeverity.title: DiagnosticSeverity

DriverCapabilities.description:
What this machine can do: whether sessions can start (and why not), the engine, the
``claude`` version, the model aliases offered, and the cloud commands the CLI lists.
DriverCapabilities.title: DriverCapabilities

EvalRecord.description:
One evaluation of a delivery: ``evals/<delivery>.md``, or the legacy ``eval.md``.

``path`` is relative to the hub's ``brain/``. ``acs`` is the AC ids evaluated or ``"all"``;
``evaluated_at`` is the frontmatter's text (an ISO date or time). ``problem`` says why the
file could not be read or parsed; its other fields are then empty.
EvalRecord.title: EvalRecord

EventSource.description: Where an event comes from; with ``source_id`` it identifies the event.
EventSource.title: EventSource

EventType.description: The closed list of event types in the SPEC; widening it later is a compatible change.
EventType.title: EventType

ExternalBlocker.description: A blocker outside the feature's tickets, with its status when Linear returned it.
ExternalBlocker.title: ExternalBlocker

ExternalPlugin.description:
A third-party plugin named by ``enabledPlugins`` or the marketplace (D1, P7); its content
is not in the hub and is never fetched. ``pin`` is the pinned sha or ref, or None.
ExternalPlugin.title: ExternalPlugin

FeatureDetail.description: A feature with its acceptance criteria rows, its records (D3) and every eval.
FeatureDetail.title: FeatureDetail

FeatureRecord.description:
One record file of a feature folder; ``path`` is relative to the hub's ``brain/``, so the
brain note route reads it.
FeatureRecord.title: FeatureRecord

FeatureTickets.description:
``GET /features/{project}/{slug}/tickets``: the tickets, their planning and the golden
path computed with them.

``source`` is ``linear`` when a snapshot was used (``stale`` when it is the last good one
after a failure; ``as_of`` is when it was read), else ``plan``, with a ``notice`` and the
``tracker_problem`` naming the cause.
FeatureTickets.title: FeatureTickets

FeatureView.description:
A feature as the Features list shows it; ``problem`` when a file of it is malformed.

``phase`` equals ``golden_path.phase``; ``tickets_source`` says whether the ticket counts
behind the golden path came from Linear or from the plan.
FeatureView.title: FeatureView

FindingView.description: A finding of a registered hub's doctor run.
FindingView.title: FindingView

FrontmatterPair.description: One frontmatter key in file order; ``known`` when Claude Code understands the key.
FrontmatterPair.title: FrontmatterPair

GateChoice.description: A decision or option a person may pick, with its label.
GateChoice.title: GateChoice

GateDecided.description: What a decision did: the gate's approval, its run and project, and the answer's id.
GateDecided.title: GateDecided

GateDecisionRequest.description: The body of ``POST /approvals/{id}/decision``: a decision or option id and/or a text.
GateDecisionRequest.title: GateDecisionRequest

GoldenPath.description:
The feature's steps in their fixed order; ``phase`` is the first step neither done nor
skipped (``shipped`` when all are).
GoldenPath.title: GoldenPath

GoldenStep.description:
One step of the golden path: its state, a short ``meta`` text and the ``reason`` it is
not done (naming the failing gate), and its ``progress`` when it counts something.
GoldenStep.title: GoldenStep

HookAccepted.description: ``POST /events/hooks``: how many events the envelope added and how many were known.
HookAccepted.title: HookAccepted

HookDecision.description: What the guard or the Stop gate decided, sent with the hook input that caused it.
HookDecision.title: HookDecision

HookEnvelope.description:
Version 1 of the sensor's envelope.

``project`` comes from the hub's ``hub.json``; ``repo`` from the hook's cwd (a repo checkout
or one of its worktrees), else None; ``run``, ``step`` and ``attempt`` from the variables
``hub run`` sets for its session. ``hook`` is the Claude Code hook input as received, with
oversized strings already omitted by the sensor.
HookEnvelope.title: HookEnvelope

HookFacts.description: A hook as configured (D4): ``command`` is inert text, never run.
HookFacts.title: HookFacts

HubCreate.description: ``POST /hubs``: the absolute path of a hub to register.
HubCreate.title: HubCreate

HubView.description:
A registered hub as read now.

``valid`` is false when ``hub.json`` is unreadable or does not match the schema
(``validation_errors``). A pin other than the running version is read anyway and shows as
a warning ("pinned X, running Y").
HubView.title: HubView

IssueRef.description: The tracker issue a run works on; title and url need Linear (``null`` in Phase 2).
IssueRef.title: IssueRef

IssueState.description: An issue's workflow state: its ``name`` in the team and Linear's state ``type``.
IssueState.title: IssueState

Learning.description:
A learning; ``text`` is its title (120 characters at most, redacted).

``target`` is deprecated (it names the inbox note); ``note_path`` says so explicitly (L12).
``state`` is ``None`` until read with the hub. ``summary`` is the note's first paragraph,
read on request; ``note_unavailable`` and ``actions_unavailable`` give the reason the note
cannot be read or the learning cannot be accepted or rejected here.
Learning.title: Learning

LearningActionResult.description: What an accept or reject did: the pull request it opened and its branch.
LearningActionResult.title: LearningActionResult

LearningDetail.description:
A learning with its note (``None`` when unavailable), the destination folder the accept
dialog suggests and the folders it offers (L9).
LearningDetail.title: LearningDetail

LearningState.description:
Where the learning's note is (L11): in the inbox, in an open PR, or moved by a merge.

``in_brain`` and ``archived`` are inferred from the hub checkout (the note sits at its
destination), since GitHub is not connected.
LearningState.title: LearningState

LearningStatus.description: Where a learning is: proposed until a terminal event in source order decides it.
LearningStatus.title: LearningStatus

LearningTarget.description: Where a learning would go: team brain, a repo's AGENTS.md, or personal memory.
LearningTarget.title: LearningTarget

LiveTile.description:
A session tile of the Live sessions screen.

``agent`` is deprecated (``label`` and ``actors``); ``needs_you_problem`` is the owner-facing
line of the first problem that needs the owner ("Needs you: <kind> in <where>");
``agent_session_id`` is the agent session ``hub web`` drives it from, when there is one.
LiveTile.title: LiveTile

LockFacts.description: What ``hub.lock`` says of the item's file: its ownership and, when managed, its sha256.
LockFacts.title: LockFacts

LogRecord.description: One persisted record of a session's log.
LogRecord.title: LogRecord

LogRecordPage.description:
``GET /{id}/events``: records after ``after`` in ``seq`` order; ``next_after`` is the
``after`` of the next page, None on the last one.
LogRecordPage.title: LogRecordPage

Mode.description: Who can invoke a skill (S5, L2); ``neither`` reads "Hidden" in the UI.
Mode.title: Mode

NeedsYouItem.description: A verb-first line of the Needs you list.
NeedsYouItem.title: NeedsYouItem

OpenPermission.description:
The permission request a live session waits on, as memory holds it (E10).

``summary`` is the input summary (at most 4 KiB); ``input`` is the tool input only for an
``AskUserQuestion`` (its questions) or a plan approval (its plan), None for a tool.
OpenPermission.title: OpenPermission

Origin.description:
Who owns an item (S4): ``managed`` per ``hub.lock``, ``project-owned`` (any other plugin
folder, ``settings.project.json``), ``local`` (a real entry in ``.claude/``).
Origin.title: Origin

Outcome.description: How an ended session ended; ``None`` when no source says.
Outcome.title: Outcome

PastSession.description:
A Claude session of a working directory that can be resumed; ``title`` is redacted and
at most 200 characters.
PastSession.title: PastSession

PermissionDecision.description:
``POST /{id}/permissions/{request_id}`` (E7).

``allow`` may carry ``answers`` (an ``AskUserQuestion``) or ``mode`` (a plan approval);
``deny`` may carry ``message``; ``always`` needs ``suggestion``, the index of the
``localSettings`` rule to keep. Any other combination is refused (422); whether the fields
fit the request is the permission policy's check.
PermissionDecision.title: PermissionDecision

PermissionSuggestion.description:
A rule Claude suggests for "always allow"; ``index`` is its position in the request,
``rule`` is passed back to the CLI verbatim. Only ``localSettings`` ones are offered (D5).
PermissionSuggestion.title: PermissionSuggestion

Problem.description:
One problem of a session and the event it comes from.

``where`` is the command head, path, pattern, URL, MCP tool or skill of the paired tool
call (derived on read, at most 120 characters); ``message`` is the stored ``error_message``,
else ``error_line``, else the rule or the gate's command and exit code.
Problem.title: Problem

ProblemCounts.description:
A session's problems by owner-facing status (S4, E5); ``handled`` = recovered or
continued by the agent.
ProblemCounts.title: ProblemCounts

ProblemDetails.description: An RFC 9457 problem; extension members (``errors``) are allowed.
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

ProjectNow.description: ``brain/now.md`` split into its sections; ``problem`` when it cannot be read.
ProjectNow.title: ProjectNow

ProjectSummary.description:
A Portfolio card: hub config plus the project's activity; PRs and issues need sources
not connected in Phase 2 (``null``).
ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

PullRequestRef.description: A pull request; GitHub is not connected in Phase 2, so sessions carry ``null``.
PullRequestRef.title: PullRequestRef

Relation.description: A link to another item of the catalog (Uses / Used by).
Relation.title: Relation

RepoView.description: A repo of the project as ``hub.json`` and its checkout describe it.
RepoView.title: RepoView

Resolution.description:
How a problem ended (S4 with E5).

``recovered`` and ``agent_continued`` show as "Handled by the agent", ``open`` as "Agent is
on it", ``needs_you`` as "Needs you" and ``by_you`` as "You interrupted" or "You declined".
Resolution.title: Resolution

ResumableList.description: ``GET /agent-sessions/resumable``: past Claude sessions of a workdir, newest first.
ResumableList.title: ResumableList

RunAccepted.description: What a run command did: the run, its project and the action taken.
RunAccepted.title: RunAccepted

RunCaps.description: The limits a run started with.
RunCaps.title: RunCaps

RunFailure.description: Where and why a run failed, and the event to open ("Open failing moment").
RunFailure.title: RunFailure

RunGateResult.description: A gate the executor ran (``gate_ok`` or a failed check).
RunGateResult.title: RunGateResult

RunStep.description: One step attempt, keyed ``(key, attempt)``; a loop back into verify is attempt 2.
RunStep.title: RunStep

Screenshot.description:
A PNG of the screen sent with the first prompt, base64-encoded; its decoded size and
signature are checked by ``decode_screenshot`` (413, 422).
Screenshot.title: Screenshot

SearchHit.description: A search result over ids, paths, commands and tool names; never payload bodies.
SearchHit.title: SearchHit

Session.description:
A session folded from its events (status, counts, tokens, estimated cost).

``agent`` is deprecated: ``actors`` and ``label`` say who acted and what the session is about.
``agent_session_id`` is the agent session ``hub web`` drives it from, when there is one.
The tile fields (``waiting_reason`` to ``sparkline_60s``) are what a Live tile shows,
derived by the same code (D5); lists and the session read fill them, other reads leave them
``null``. ``sparkline_60s`` is ``null`` once the session has ended.
Session.title: Session

SessionCost.description: The Cost tab: per-turn series and totals, always "Estimated from transcript" (D15).
SessionCost.title: SessionCost

SessionFileChange.description: A path a session touched, its operations and line counts (no content is stored).
SessionFileChange.title: SessionFileChange

SessionLabel.description:
What a session is about, derived on read (S1): issue, workflow, repo and branch.

``issue`` is ``<TEAM>-<n>`` found in ``branch`` or ``worktree`` with the hub's tracker teams,
else ``None``, never a guess. ``workflow`` is the session's main slash command or skill
(``/feature``); ``workflows`` lists every one in order. ``worktree`` is the folder name under
``.claude/worktrees/`` in the session's ``cwd``. ``title`` is the session's short name: the
one the user set (``/rename``), else the one Claude Code wrote (ADR 0034), else ``None``.
SessionLabel.title: SessionLabel

SessionProblems.description:
The problems route: up to 5 deterministic summary lines, then every problem by time.

``summary`` is empty when the session has no problem.
SessionProblems.title: SessionProblems

SessionSegment.description: One stretch of a session; a later event after an end reopens it as a new segment.
SessionSegment.title: SessionSegment

SessionSettings.description: ``POST /{id}/settings``: a new mode, a new model, or both (at least one).
SessionSettings.title: SessionSettings

SessionStatus.description: Where a session is now (D14): waiting wins over live; ended is final until reopened.
SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus

SessionSummary.description: 3 to 5 deterministic lines (D17); a stored ``session.summary`` event wins (``stored``).
SessionSummary.title: SessionSummary

SettingsView.description: Read-only settings of the running ``hub web`` (no ``PATCH`` in Phase 2).
SettingsView.title: SettingsView

SkillCatalog.description:
A project's skills, agents and hooks in stable order (kind, name, source).

``truncated`` says a bound stopped the listing or the reads; ``notice`` is one line for the
owner (an empty hub, a file not read), or None.
SkillCatalog.title: SkillCatalog

SkillDetail.description:
One item's detail page (D4, AC-164.8): the card's fields and what the file says.

``body`` is the text after the frontmatter and ``raw`` the whole file decoded as UTF-8; both
are None when the file was not read (too large, not regular, not text, over budget). A hook
has ``hook`` set and no body, structure or cost.
SkillDetail.title: SkillDetail

SkillStructure.description:
What the body's text says it does, derived heuristically (S6): labelled so in the UI.

``dynamic_context`` counts the ``!`…``` and ```` ```! ```` blocks that run at invocation (shown
as text, never run); ``truncated`` when steps past the bound were dropped.
SkillStructure.title: SkillStructure

SourceStatus.description: When a source last sent an event, and whether that is recent enough.
SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus

Stage.description: A state of the run's machine; any stage before ``REPORTED`` can end in ``FAILED``.
Stage.title: Stage

StartCloud.description: ``POST /agent-sessions/cloud``: a task for ``claude --cloud``, passed as one argument.
StartCloud.title: StartCloud

StartRunRequest.description: The body of ``POST /workflow-runs``: a project's workflow and its inputs (always live).
StartRunRequest.title: StartRunRequest

Step.description: One top-level ordered list item of a body (S6); ``index`` is 1-based, as ``#step-<n>``.
Step.title: Step

StepProgress.description: How much of a step is done: ``done`` of ``total`` (tickets, ACs, reviews).
StepProgress.title: StepProgress

SummaryLine.description: One line of a session summary and the event it comes from.
SummaryLine.title: SummaryLine

TicketEdge.description: A "blocked by" edge to the ticket ``ref`` (a row's ``ref`` or an external issue id).
TicketEdge.title: TicketEdge

TicketPlan.description:
The planning of the feature's tickets, every ticket named by its row's ``ref``.

``layers`` are the parallel groups (Kahn's layers over tickets not done or canceled);
``can_start`` the first layer's tickets that wait on nothing and are not started yet; ``order`` the recommended
order; ``waiting`` the tickets with a blocker not done; ``cycles`` each dependency cycle
(left out of the layers); ``critical_path`` the longest chain of tickets not done.
TicketPlan.title: TicketPlan

TicketRow.description:
One ticket of the feature.

``key`` is the plan's draft key (None for a ticket only Linear or ``linear`` lists), ``id``
the tracker identifier (None until created). ``title``, ``state``, ``assignee`` and ``url``
come from Linear when read, else ``title`` from the plan and the others None. ``acs`` are the
AC ids whose ``ticket`` names it; ``blocks`` the refs it blocks; ``waiting_on`` the refs of
its blockers not done yet. ``reviewed`` is None when unknown (no snapshot and no record).
TicketRow.title: TicketRow

TimelineEvent.description:
One stored event as the timeline and Raw events show it.

``fact_key`` groups copies of the same fact from several sources; ``merged_sources`` lists
them on the winner; a loser has ``conflict`` set (D16). ``latency_ms`` is ``received_at``
minus ``timestamp`` when both exist.
TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent

TocEntry.description: One heading of a body (outside fenced code); the web computes its anchor (P5).
TocEntry.title: TocEntry

TokenUsage.description: Tokens counted from transcript usage, once per message id.
TokenUsage.title: TokenUsage

TrackerProblem.description:
Why Linear was not read, as RFC 9457 members: ``type`` is
``urn:agent-hub:problem:tracker-<kind>``, ``status`` Linear's HTTP status (or 503 when it did
not answer, 504 on a timeout).
TrackerProblem.title: TrackerProblem

TurnCost.description: Tokens and estimated cost of one turn.
TurnCost.title: TurnCost

Usage.description:
How often a skill or agent was used in the window: counts and a time only (D6, ADR 0019).

``user_count`` counts invocations typed by a person, ``model_count`` the ones the model made.
Usage.title: Usage

ValidationProblem.description: One problem of a hub's ``hub.json``, located by a JSON pointer.
ValidationProblem.title: ValidationProblem

Workdir.description:
A folder a session may start in (D6): the hub, a repo checkout or one of its worktrees.

``workdir_id`` is opaque and stable; the server resolves it only by lookup. ``skills`` are
the names under its ``.claude/skills/`` (the ``/skill`` shortcut, P15).
Workdir.title: Workdir

WorkdirList.description: ``GET /agent-sessions/workdirs``; ``warnings`` name folders that could not be read.
WorkdirList.title: WorkdirList

WorkflowCatalogView.description: The workflows that load, by project then name, and every problem found.
WorkflowCatalogView.title: WorkflowCatalogView

WorkflowDetail.description:
A workflow's layers (in run order, nodes in declaration order) and its document as
written (keys left out are not filled in).
WorkflowDetail.title: WorkflowDetail

WorkflowGate.description: An open gate a person answers: where it is and what answers it.
WorkflowGate.title: WorkflowGate

WorkflowNodeView.description: A node as the graph shows it: its id, type and the nodes it waits for.
WorkflowNodeView.title: WorkflowNodeView

WorkflowProblemView.description:
Why a file of a project's hub is not a workflow: ``file`` is hub-relative (a built-in's
starts ``<builtin>/``), ``line`` is 1-based when known, ``key`` is ``$`` for the file.
WorkflowProblemView.title: WorkflowProblemView

WorkflowRun.description:
A run folded from executor events (D9, D16): the first ``run.end`` wins, the highest
``n`` for an engine run. ``stage`` is issue-to-pr's machine (another workflow's live run is
``PICKED``); ``status`` and ``outcome`` hold for every workflow.
WorkflowRun.title: WorkflowRun

WorkflowSummary.description: A workflow of a project's hub, and where it comes from (``source``).
WorkflowSummary.title: WorkflowSummary
